review.tagline: CLI that installs SKILL.md agent skills into dozens of coding agents
review.summary: An npm CLI (`npx skills`) that fetches skills defined as SKILL.md files from GitHub, GitLab, Azure Repos, any git URL, a local path or an archive URL, and installs them into each coding agent's skills directory. It supports project or global scope and symlinked or copied installs, and it adds list, find, update, remove and init commands. The README lists about 80 supported agents, including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode.
review.audience: Developers sharing or installing agent skills across several coding agents
strengths: One command installs a skill into many agents' directories, using symlinks to a canonical copy
Accepts GitHub shorthand, GitLab, Azure Repos, any git URL, local paths and archive URLs
Private repos use existing Git credentials, GitHub CLI or SSH; a token is optional
Non-interactive flags (-y, --all, -g, -a) make it usable in CI
weaknesses: Needs Node.js and npx; the README does not state a minimum version
Only manages skills; it does not supply the agents themselves
Agent support depends on a hand-maintained table of paths for each agent
Symlinks may not work on every platform; copy mode is the fallback
